lead: A subclass fixture with its own constructor must call `parent::constructor(...)` on every path, or `E0410` fails it.
body: A `class Dog extends Animal { public function constructor(string $n, int $age) {} }` written to make `rule:classes/constructor-compatibility`'s case plausible is itself refused, so an `assert!(!diags.has_errors())` fails on a diagnostic the author never considered, worst in a negative fixture's control half. One `parent::constructor($n);` line fixes it.
